items.summary: You can now use expiring, automatically refreshing OAuth credentials in GitHub CLI as part of a public preview. When you opt in, gh stores an expiring access token alongside a rotating refresh token and automatically refreshes the token whenever it is needed.

items.author: Ben Thompson
items.description: Stratechery is now presented by Stripe. What that means for me, for you, and for the future of Stratechery content.
items.summary: The Unified Content Business Model Readers have, over the years, pointed out the paradox of my belief in and advocacy for advertising-based business models being delivered in a format bereft of advertising. And, thankfully, readers were willing to pay, and ultimately, there ended up being far more such readers than I ever dreamed of.
